heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Division 9—Change in ownership of international registration
text: If the change of ownership has effect in Australia, the Registrar must record it in the Record of International Registrations. Note: If regulation 17A.57, 17A.58 or 17A.59 does not apply to the trade mark, the change of ownership of the international registration has effect in Australia in accordance with the Protocol.
